summary: LAUKVIK SAMFUNNSHUS SA (org. no. 987 318 198) is a cooperative (SA) based in Vågan, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2004-10-23. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 68.200 (Utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom); it has 0 registered employees. Board chair: Ann Jorunn Olsen.
